sources.title: Storm petrel
sources.publisher_description:
A species of a small seabird in the Hydrobatidae family. The storm petrel Hydrobates pelagicus (Linnaeus, 1758) inhabits the European shores of the Atlantic and the western shores of the Mediterranean Sea. It is often found on rocky islands with high cliffs, far from inhabited places, in West Ireland, North West Scotland and the Faroe Islands. In winter, it reaches the western and southern coasts of Africa.

ID no.: Z/155/MT

Time of creation:  1885

Museum: The Dr. Tytus Chałubiński Tatra Museum in Zakopane

https://muzea.malopolska.pl/en/objects-list/1824

sources.title: Model 75A - Harbor Porpoise
sources.publisher_description:
This is a 3D animation of a live harbor porpoise ("Freja", Female, Total Length of 155.5 cm) that was recreated using a combination of photogrammetry, photography and video.  This work was done in collaboration with Peter Madsen and Fredrik Christensen from the University of Aarhaus, CG artist Johnson Martin and others. The Fjord Baelt in Denmark kindly allowed us access to the animal.

Mesh accuracy was confirmed through correlation between digital and live measures.

Downloads are freely available for creative and non-profit use. To inquire about licensing, please visit **www.digitallife3d.org**.
